item.title: Spain’s Parliament backs citizenship for Western Saharans born before 1977
item.description: After lower house approval, the bill to grant tens of thousands of Sahrawis citizenship now goes to the Spanish Senate.

item.title: LG defends smart-TV features amid audio surveillance allegations
item.description: Recent accusations against the electronics company have raised new questions about the nonconsensual data it harvests.

item.title: Peru joins US-led ‘Shield of the Americas’ security alliance
item.description: Fujimori administration is latest right-wing government to join alliance for a more aggressive approach against crime.

item.title: Republican midterm convention live: Trump, Vance headline day two in Dallas
item.description: US Republicans return to the stage to close their midterm convention, still betting on Trump's political magnetism.

item.title: Israel says it destroyed key Hezbollah tunnels in southern Lebanon
item.description: Israel’s military says it has destroyed a network of Hezbollah tunnels on the strategic Ali al-Taher ridge in Lebanon.

item.title: Gaza hospitals ration power as fuel shortages deepen
item.description: Fuel and engine oil shortages are forcing Gaza’s hospitals to ration electricity

item.title: Russian strike hits shopping centre in central Ukraine
item.description: A Russian strike on a shopping centre in the central Ukrainian city of Pavlohrad killed at least four people.

item.title: Drones recreate Twin Towers in tribute ahead of 9/11 anniversary
item.description: Thousands of drones were used to recreate New York’s Twin Towers in a tribute ahead of the 25th anniversary of 9/11.

item.title: Manchester United beat Sabah 4-0 on Champions League return
item.description: Goals from Matheus Cunha, Bruno Fernandes, Benjamin Sesko and Lisandro Martinez seal a winning UCL return for United.

item.title: Morocco denies involvement in migrant surge into Spain’s Ceuta
item.description: Over 70,000 migrants entered Ceuta, sparking a humanitarian crisis and political tensions between Spain and Morocco.

item.title: Will foreign workers leave South Africa?
item.description: Anti-immigrant protests in the country are back.

item.title: What’s happening in Yemen and how did we get here?
item.description: Fighting has reignited in Yemen as Houthi forces push south towards the strategic Bab al-Mandab Strait.

item.title: US appeals court rejects Trump bid to implement new vote-by-mail rules
item.description: The ruling is a blow to Trump administration's efforts to change how mail-in voting works ahead of November elections.

item.title: Could Pakistan enter Yemen conflict under Mecca agreement?
item.description: Pakistan says no military response has been discussed under its new defence pact with Saudi Arabia and Turkiye.

item.title: Algeria cuts diplomatic ties with UAE: What we know
item.description: Algiers ends relations with Gulf state over 'provocative and hostile' actions, after years of tensions.

item.title: Jimmy Kimmel moves Talarico Senate interview to YouTube amid clash with FCC
item.description: The decision follows a year of surging regulatory hurdles over candidate appearances on the Disney-owned network.

item.title: Amnesty accuses Russia of trafficking foreigners to fight in Ukraine
item.description: Report reveals foreign nationals were misled with job offers, then forced into Russia's army upon arrival.

item.title: Fire onboard ship at Chinese shipyard kills 25 people
item.description: At least 25 people were killed after a fire broke out aboard a ship at a shipyard in China.

item.title: England close in on Pakistan whitewash in third Test as Robinson shines
item.description: Demoralised tourists reach 52-2 before rain ends play early on day two, needing 268 runs to make England bat again.

item.title: More than a dozen children killed in fire in eastern DR Congo schools
item.description: Authorities say at least 14 school children have been killed after fire ravaged schools in the DR Congo.

item.title: Climate hazards disrupted school for 1 in 10 students in 2025: UNICEF
item.description: More than 171 million students affected globally with girls disproportionately impacted.

item.title: Family of four killed as they slept in Israeli strike on Gaza
item.description: Four members of a Palestinian family, including girls aged 8 and 12, were killed in an Israeli air attack as they slept

item.title: Kurdish YPJ women fighters face exclusion from Syria’s new army
item.description: Syria’s Kurdish women fighters in northeast Syria as pushing to join the country’s new army.

item.title: The Trump-to-Mamdani voter is real. How does the trend affect the midterms?
item.description: Exit polls suggest 9 percent of Trump voters backed New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani, despite ideological differences.

item.title: Israel arrests 100 Palestinians in a week as West Bank pogroms continue
item.description: Palestinian Prisoner’s Society says detained include children, journalists and ex-prisoner freed in recent exchange deal
